claim_boundary: These plans encode a best-case, source-aware execution intention for eight already frozen teacher-suitable states. They test whether the fixed generator can use a correct plan; they must never train or evaluate the learned PM.

plans.immediate_goal: Help the user support the co-worker without taking over the co-worker's decision or increasing workplace exposure.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source suggests repeated proximity at work, so any support option should remain low-pressure and respect the other person's agency; it does not prove the relationship is a friendship or that the old arrangement is unchanged.
plans.good_use: If the user is still seeing the co-worker regularly, center the co-worker's wishes: ask privately what kind of support would feel helpful, without pressuring her or acting on her behalf.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not draft a complaint for her, act on her behalf, call the user a close friend, or treat the past daily contact as certainly current.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if a safe current-context answer already centers consent and agency.

plans.immediate_goal: Validate the breakup-related self-doubt while letting the user choose whether work stress is part of what they want to unpack now.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source says work once felt on a better track. It is a stale comparison point, not evidence that work is currently good or bad.
plans.good_use: If natural, make one tentative check about whether work has changed since it previously felt more stable, then return control of the focus to the user.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not abandon the breakup concern, assume work deteriorated, or present the old work status as current.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if mentioning work would displace the user's immediate breakup and self-worth concern.

plans.immediate_goal: Help the user decide how much vulnerability feels safe with people who have shown support.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source suggests that talking something through has helped before, but it does not identify which person is safe now.
plans.good_use: Offer a low-pressure way to start small, such as sharing one limited concern with one person who has already been supportive, while preserving the option to stop.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not claim that talking always helps, identify a safe person without evidence, or turn the reply into a generic self-care menu.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if the same small-step invitation follows completely from the current dialogue.

plans.immediate_goal: Acknowledge sustained strain and help the user identify one manageable source of support or relief without giving unsolicited business consulting.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source links the user's business difficulty to a broader loss of enjoyment and everyday functioning, suggesting the burden may extend beyond sales numbers.
plans.good_use: Tentatively acknowledge that this may have been draining for some time and ask which part feels least sustainable or what small support would reduce the load now.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not diagnose depression, prescribe a business strategy, or state that the old loss of enjoyment is still present.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if the current 'not sure how long I can keep this up' already fully supports the same burden-sensitive response.

plans.immediate_goal: Help Kelly identify her own preference before organizing around either family's expectations.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source adds that her parents previously reacted to travel with traditional beliefs and pressure; it explains why the current choice may carry more than ordinary scheduling tension.
plans.good_use: Gently note that family expectations may be adding pressure, then ask what Kelly herself wants or needs from the holiday before discussing communication.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not ask her to predict her parents' reaction, reinforce guilt, decide between families, or assume the old pressure remains unchanged.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if it cannot be used while keeping Kelly's own preference as the center of the reply.

plans.immediate_goal: Help Alex separate grief about Monica from the effect of parental disapproval and explore what the counterfactual means to him now.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source confirms there was a difficult conversation about a possible California move, but the current dialogue already contains most of that structure.
plans.good_use: Only if it adds clarity, ask whether the painful part is missing Monica, feeling his choice was constrained, or doubting his own decision.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not imply moving would have saved the relationship, blame the parents, or intensify the counterfactual as fact.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused when the current dialogue already supports the same distinction without it.

plans.immediate_goal: Move away from gender stereotypes and invite the user to describe the actual unresolved friendship conflict.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source suggests the user previously wondered whether a conflict was being covered over rather than worked through.
plans.good_use: Tentatively ask whether something in their own friendship still feels unresolved or superficially smoothed over.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not endorse claims about girls in general, expose the remembered statement, or assert that the friendship is currently unresolved.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if the source cannot be connected to the user's own experience without making an unsupported assumption.

plans.immediate_goal: Help Jamie clarify whether she wants understanding, reconnection, or self-protection in relation to Ann.
plans.candidate_increment: The past source suggests she previously considered stepping back when care seemed unreciprocated, which may illuminate the current fear that Ann does not care.
plans.good_use: Tentatively ask what she most needs to learn or protect before reaching out, without assuming Ann's motives.
plans.forbidden_focus_shift: Do not discuss Ann's husband, declare that Ann does not care, or push Jamie to confront or withdraw.
plans.nonuse_condition: Leave the memory unused if the person's identity cannot be linked safely or if current context already supplies the same uncertainty.
